content.thinking: This is a gas smell emergency, so safety comes first. I need to message the tenant, create an emergency ticket (unrelated to the existing tap ticket R-4801), assign HeatRight as contractor, escalate to P1, and notify the landlord. I'll create the ticket first since assigning the contractor needs a ticket reference, while sending the tenant message in parallel.

arguments.body: Hi Amelia, a rotten-egg smell from a boiler can be a gas leak, so please treat this as an emergency tonight. Please: 1) Get everyone out of the flat now, including your flatmate's mum (82), who should be helped out first. 2) Don't use light switches, flames, or the boiler. If it's safe, open doors and windows on your way out. 3) Once outside, call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24h). Call 999 if anyone feels unwell. 4) Is the CO alarm in the kitchen sounding? Does anyone have a headache, dizziness, nausea or drowsiness? Please reply to confirm everyone is out. We're sending a Gas Safe engineer to make it safe tonight and will update you. Please don't go back in until they or the gas emergency service say it's safe.

arguments.description: Tenant reports rotten-egg (gas) smell from Worcester 30i combi boiler when it fires up, reported 22:40 on 2026-10-09. 82-year-old visitor in the flat. Gas Safe engineer to make safe tonight.

arguments.body: Hi Amelia, a rotten-egg smell from a boiler can be a gas leak, so please treat this as an emergency tonight. Please: 1) Get everyone out of the flat now, including your flatmate's mum (82), who should be helped out first. 2) Don't use light switches, flames, or the boiler. If it's safe, open doors and windows on your way out. 3) Once outside, call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24h). Call 999 if anyone feels unwell. 4) Is the CO alarm in the kitchen sounding? Does anyone have a headache, dizziness, nausea or drowsiness? Please reply to confirm everyone is out. We're sending a Gas Safe engineer to make it safe tonight and will update you. Please don't go back in until they or the gas emergency service say it's safe.
